title: Vivumishi (Theme 1: Nyumbani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds the noun first, then the word that tells more about it, in the form that agrees with the noun.

floor.prerequisite: Finds the noun in a sentence.
floor.question: Nomino ni ipi: "Kiti kipya kimefika."

representations: picture cards of big/small, old/new things
noun and adjective cards that must agree
steps: Ask: what kind? how many? what colour?
Give the adjective the noun's prefix.
Put the adjective after the noun.

board.say: Kiti ni cha ngeli ipi? Kivumishi kitakuwaje?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "kiti kikubwa" and "viti vikubwa".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mtoto ___ anacheza uwanjani." Kwa nini "mwalimu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kivumishi kinaeleza nomino ikoje, kama "mdogo". "Mwalimu" ni nomino.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Nyumba ___ ina bustani." Kwa nini "inaonekana" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kivumishi kinaeleza nomino ikoje: nyumba nzuri. "Inaonekana" ni kitenzi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Watoto ___ wanacheza." Kwa nini "mdogo" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kivumishi hubadilika kulingana na nomino: mtoto mdogo, watoto wadogo; kiti kikubwa, viti vikubwa.

misconceptions.ask: Ni neno lipi ni jina, na linakaa wapi?
misconceptions.repair: Katika Kiswahili, nomino hutangulia kivumishi: mtoto mzuri, nyumba kubwa.
